title: Critique: the combination problem has many parts, all to be solved

statements.text: How micro-level experience combines into human experience splits into a subject combination problem, a quality combination problem and a structure combination problem, with unity, boundary, awareness and grain problems beside them. A satisfactory solution must address all of them, and none proposed so far has gained much support.

sources.quote: These three aspects yield what we might call the subject combination problem, the quality combination problem, and the structure combination problem.
It should be stressed that a satisfactory solution to the combination problem must address all of these problems.
It is fair to say that no proposed solution has yet gained much support, however.
